name: Recruit Training Command, Great Lakes
note: Public location of the Navy's recruit training command. Not a home address.

name: Naval Station San Diego (32nd Street)
note: Naval Base San Diego on 32nd Street, where the NEC 1460 (COMSEC maintenance) school was taken. Until this update the NCTS tour was pinned here; NCTS itself was at FISC San Diego downtown and later at NAS North Island.

name: Naval Base Guam
note: Public location of the home port used by USS Frank Cable and by EOD Mobile Unit Five in these years. Frank Cable berthed at Polaris Point, on this base. That pier is not the Polaris off-road vehicle.

name: Polaris Point
note: The AS-40 berth on Naval Base Guam, Inner Apra Harbor. A place, not the Polaris off-road vehicle.

name: Naval Air Station Jacksonville
note: Public location of the air station. SERCC was on this base.

name: Naval Hospital Jacksonville
note: Public site at plus code 862W6858+HH (6858+HH, Southwest, Jacksonville, Florida).

name: MacDill Air Force Base
note: Public location of MacDill, where Joint Communications Support Element is based.

name: Mosul
note: City of Mosul. The 52nd Ordnance Group (EOD) linked up here in OIF I, January to June 2006. APPROXIMATE: the pin is the city, not a named compound.

name: FOB Sykes
locality: Tal Afar Air Base, near Tal Afar, Nineveh, Iraq
note: Forward Operating Base Sykes, the former Iraqi Tal Afar Air Base south of Tal Afar, run by U.S. forces from 2003 to 2011. Coordinates: the airfield (Wikipedia, ICAO ORTF).

name: FOB Tal Afar
note: U.S. base in the city of Tal Afar, Iraq. APPROXIMATE: the pin is the center of Tal Afar, not the base itself.

name: Joint Base Balad (LSA Anaconda)
note: Former Iraqi Al-Bakr Air Base, known to the Army as Logistics Support Area Anaconda. It was the largest U.S. base in Iraq. Coordinates: the airfield (Wikipedia).

name: FOB Delaram
note: Forward Operating Base Delaram, built by the U.S. Marine Corps on the Ring Road at Delaram, used from 2007 to 2014. APPROXIMATE: public directory coordinates.

name: FOB Orgun-E
note: Forward Operating Base Orgun-E, later Camp Harriman, near Orgun in Paktika Province. APPROXIMATE: crowd-sourced map coordinates.

name: FISC San Diego (downtown)
note: Fleet and Industrial Supply Center San Diego on the downtown waterfront (Broadway Complex). NCTS San Diego was here before it moved to NAS North Island.

name: NAS North Island
note: Naval Air Station North Island, Coronado. NCTS San Diego's later location.

name: Imperial Beach Elephant Cage
note: The Imperial Beach annex, the elephant cage, at plus code 8544HVVC+99M (HVVC+99M, Coronado, California). The NEC 9613 (NSW Communications Technician) school was taken at this annex.

name: Keesler Air Force Base
note: Keesler AFB, Biloxi. Where the FECL calibration school (NEC 1589) was taken.

name: Naval Amphibious Base Little Creek
note: NAB Little Creek (now Joint Expeditionary Base Little Creek–Fort Story), homeport of USS Tortuga (LSD-46). TAD to the ship.

name: Saipan
note: Port visit to Saipan (Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands) with USS Frank Cable.

name: Yokosuka Naval Base
note: Port visit to Commander Fleet Activities Yokosuka with USS Frank Cable.

name: Sasebo Naval Base
note: Port visit to Commander Fleet Activities Sasebo with USS Frank Cable.

name: Hong Kong
note: Port visit to Hong Kong with USS Frank Cable.

name: U-Tapao Air Base
note: Exercise Cobra Gold at U-Tapao, Thailand, with EODMU 5.

name: Camp Growl
locality: Shoalwater Bay Training Area, Queensland, Australia
note: Camp Growl in the Shoalwater Bay Training Area, north of Rockhampton. Exercise Talisman Saber, twice, with EODMU 5.

name: NAS Whidbey Island
note: Naval Air Station Whidbey Island, Oak Harbor. A stop with EODMU 5.

name: Duhok Dam, Kurdistan
note: The Duhok Dam just north of Duhok, with the giant Kurdistan flag on the hillside above the reservoir. A visit with CJTF Troy in 2006.

name: Fort Bragg
note: Fort Bragg, North Carolina. Training with JCSE.

name: Camp Blanding
note: Camp Blanding Joint Training Center, Florida. Training with JCSE.

name: FOB Patriot
note: A training FOB at Fort Bragg, 35°8'33"N 79°6'12"W. Training with JCSE.

name: Camp Arifjan (Warrior Transition Program)
note: The Navy's Warrior Transition Program (NAVCENT Forward) at Camp Arifjan, where returning individual augmentees turned in gear, cleaned weapons and went through reintegration workshops before flying home. Out-processing here in 2009 at the end of the IA C-RAM deployment.

name: Al Udeid Air Base
note: Al Udeid Air Base, Qatar. The transit hub in and out of both Afghanistan deployments: Qatar then Bagram going in, the reverse coming out.

name: Bagram Airfield
note: Bagram Airfield, Afghanistan. The in-theater transit stop on both Afghanistan deployments, after Qatar going in and before it coming out.

name: Leipzig/Halle Airport
note: Leipzig/Halle Airport, Germany. A stopover on the 2009 Iraq trip and on both Afghanistan deployments.

name: Bitburg Airport
note: Bitburg Airport (EDRB), the former Bitburg Air Base airfield, 49°56'43"N 6°33'54"E. A stopover on the way home from the 2006 EOD deployment.

name: Naval Station Norfolk
note: Public location of Naval Station Norfolk. Safety Programs Afloat and Afloat HAZMAT Coordinator were taught at the Naval Occupational Safety, Health and Environmental Training Center here. ADAMS for Supervisors was at CPPD Detachment DAPMA Norfolk.

name: Naval Special Warfare Center, Coronado
note: Public location of the Naval Special Warfare Center / NAB Coronado, where the NSW Communications course (K-431-0141) was taken.

name: Gryphon School
note: Laurinburg–Maxton Airport, where Gryphon Group's school sits. The pin is the airfield, not a street address.

name: Fort Bliss
note: Fort Bliss, El Paso. Five months of training from October 2008 with HHB, 3rd Battalion, 3rd Air Defense Artillery. The rest of the IA was at Joint Base Balad.

name: Great Lakes
note: City-level pin for the Great Lakes / North Chicago area around Naval Station Great Lakes.

name: Virginia Beach
note: City-level pin for Virginia Beach, home of NAS Little Creek.

name: Biloxi
note: City-level pin for Biloxi, near Keesler AFB.

name: San Diego
note: City-level pin for San Diego.

name: San Francisco
note: City-level pin for San Francisco (port visit).

name: Hagåtña (Agana)
note: City-level pin for Hagåtña, formerly Agana, the capital of Guam.

name: Pattaya
note: City-level pin for Pattaya, Thailand.

name: Seattle
note: City-level pin for Seattle, Washington.

name: Oak Harbor
note: City-level pin for Oak Harbor, Washington, the town for NAS Whidbey Island.

name: Jacksonville
note: City-level pin for Jacksonville, Florida.

name: El Paso
note: City-level pin for El Paso, near Fort Bliss.

name: Baltimore
note: City-level pin for Baltimore (transit).

name: Tampa
note: City-level pin for Tampa, near MacDill AFB.

name: Leipzig
note: City-level pin for Leipzig. Transit stopovers used the airport (see leipzig place).

name: Maxton
note: City-level pin for Maxton, NC, near the Gryphon Group school at Laurinburg–Maxton Airport.

name: Fayetteville
note: City-level pin for Fayetteville, NC. Parent city for Fort Bragg, Gryphon Group, and FOB Patriot in the place sequence.

name: Yokosuka
note: City-level pin for Yokosuka (port visit).

name: Sasebo
note: City-level pin for Sasebo (port visit).

name: Hong Kong
note: City-level pin for Hong Kong (port visit).

name: Saipan
note: City-level pin for Saipan (port visit).

name: Camp Bastion
note: Camp Bastion (later Camp Shorabak), Helmand. APPROXIMATE: public directory coordinates for the airfield complex.

name: FOB Sharana
note: Forward Operating Base Sharana / Sharana Airfield, Paktika. APPROXIMATE: public airfield coordinates.
